notes:
Top-line: mid-market product analytics SaaS. Product teams evaluating Hosted API first (quickbreadth) then Dedicated for predictable unit costs once integrated. POC ran Jan-Feb: embeddings for semantic search + chat assistant in product. Good fit for Dedicated but pricing/commit structure is sticking point.

Key quotes & signals:
- "We see big token volume in peak hours; need predictable pricing for budgeting." (CTO)
- Interested in 12-18 month ramp with lower committed minimum first 3 months then step-up schedule.
- Wants burst capacity to handle weekly sync jobs and onboarding spikes; asks for clear overage math and burst caps.
- Strong security checklist: SOC2, SSO (SAML), audit logs, KMS + option for EU residency for subset of PII.

POC summary:
- POC scope: embeddings for doc search (60k docs), reranking for search results, chat assistant (internal beta).
- Metrics: embeddings latency 30-60ms p99 on hosted API; cost per 1M tokens measured vs current provider ~10-15% lower on hosted.
- Acceptable quality; small hallucination cases on long-context summarization flagged by PM.

Pricing/packaging negotiation points (active):
- Commit level: client proposes $150k ARR commit for first 12 months with step-up to $300k in month 7. Wants credit for unused committed units quarterly.
- Burst: asks for 2x burst pool for sustained 72-hour spikes with billing capped at negotiated burst rate rather than full overage.
- Overage: prefers soft overage where overage is billed at slightly premium rate but not immediate throttling; wants monthly reconciliation.
- Ramp schedule: 3-month pilot (discounted), month 4-6 gradual ramp, month 7 full commit. Wants autoscaling guarantees and SLOs for tail latency (p99 tokens).
- SLA negotiation: requires uptime SLA + latency SLO tied to credits; residency clause: EU-only dataset flows must stay in EU region.

Internal notes for AE/SE:
- SE (Diego) to provide detailed cost model showing per-token cost at commit vs overage scenarios + example invoices.
- Legal looped on residency clause (SEC-3471). Ask legal to provision standard MSA with residency addendum.
- Finance asked for month-by-month forecast of token usage; sent template on 2026-02-26.

Next steps (short):
- 2026-03-04: pricing workshop with finance + Diego to finalize commit tiers and burst SLA (scheduled).
- Deliver revised term sheet with ramp schedule and burst caps by 2026-03-06.
- Legal to return redlines by 2026-03-18.

Tone/voice: notes are shorthand, CRM-focused. Expect back-and-forth on pricing and SLO details. Keep POC artifacts linked above.
